title: Cleopatra Lived Closer to the Moon Landing Than the Pyramids

scenes.text: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
The Great Pyramid of Giza went up around the year twenty-five fifty BC. Cleopatra was born in sixty-nine BC.
That's a gap of nearly twenty-five hundred years. The Moon landing came in nineteen sixty-nine, only two thousand years after her.
So to Cleopatra, the pyramids were ancient history. Older to her than the Roman Empire is to us.
It happens because ancient Egypt lasted so long. Three thousand years of pharaohs, and she was the very last one.
Which other fact about time would break your brain? Tell me below.

description:
Cleopatra lived closer in time to the first Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid of Giza.
The Great Pyramid was built around 2550 BC. Cleopatra was born in 69 BC, almost 2,500 years later, and the Moon landing in 1969 was only about 2,000 years after her.
Ancient Egypt lasted so long that its last queen saw the pyramids as ancient ruins.
Which fact about time breaks your brain the most?
